name: Acute cardiac event screening
condition: Possible heart attack or acute coronary syndrome
description: Chest pain or pressure could be a heart attack. If ANY of these applies, stop and call 911 immediately. Do not wait.

citations.text: American Heart Association. Warning signs of a heart attack.

validated_population: Not a score. Warning signs from American Heart Association public guidance. Any one sign means call 911.
self_report_note: Women, older adults, and people with diabetes more often have heart attacks without typical chest pain.
license_note: Pattern logic and question wording are original to OLA BOT, based on the public guidance cited. Not a validated scoring instrument.

items.question: Are you having chest pain or pressure RIGHT NOW?
items.help: Any discomfort in the chest counts, even if mild.

items.question: Does (or did) it feel like pressure, heaviness, squeezing, or tightness?
items.help: Answer about any chest discomfort in the last 24 hours.

items.question: Is (or was) the pain spreading to your arm, jaw, neck, or back?
items.help: Discomfort in one or both arms, the jaw, neck, back, or upper belly.
items.trace_label: Pain spreading to arm, jaw, neck, or back

items.question: Are you also having shortness of breath, nausea, or a cold sweat?
items.help: These can come with or without chest discomfort.
items.trace_label: Shortness of breath, nausea, or cold sweat

scoring.pattern_text: Red flag if ANY sign is present: chest pain or pressure now, pressure-type discomfort, pain spreading to arm/jaw/neck/back, or shortness of breath, nausea, or cold sweat.
scoring.threshold_text: Red flag screening, not a score. Any "yes" → call 911 immediately (full-screen emergency). All "no" → same-day evaluation.

levels.label: RED FLAG PRESENT: possible heart attack
levels.interpretation: Do not wait. This could be a heart attack.

levels.label: No heart attack warning signs reported
levels.interpretation: You did not report current chest pain or heart attack warning signs.

emergency_stop.label: CALL 911 NOW
emergency_stop.interpretation: Do not wait. This could be a heart attack.

ed_redirect: Do not hang up until help arrives

same_day.label: No warning signs now: get checked today
same_day.interpretation: You did not report current chest pain or heart attack warning signs. Chest discomfort that has stopped can still come from the heart.
same_day.recommendation: See a clinician today to find the cause of your chest discomfort.

care.where_detail: Urgent care or emergency department today. Tell them you had chest discomfort.
ed_redirect: Chest pain or pressure returns: call 911
Shortness of breath, cold sweat, or fainting: call 911
